question: is professor leyk good for csce 221
answer: Students are split on Teresa Leyk (Computer Science). Recent CSCE 221 reviews say her lectures are fast and hard to follow and she calls students up to work problems, but the labs and TAs help a lot and several say she's tough but fair. A bit over half would take her again.

question: how does lupoli teach
answer: Students mostly rate Shawn Lupoli (Computer Science) below average. Reviews say his assignments open and are due at inconsistent times and some material feels recycled, though a few call him nice and his online course clear. Fewer than half would take him again.

question: is yasskin a tough grader
answer: Yes, students rate Philip Yasskin (Mathematics, MATH 171 and 221) as one of the harder math professors. They say you have to grind, homework is long, and lectures are hard to follow, though he gives out his own textbook free. Only about a third would take him again.

question: would people take keyser again
answer: Yes. Nearly all students who rated John Keyser (Computer Science, mostly CSCE 430) say they'd take him again. They call him passionate and the class fun, though there's a lot of work.

question: is dr ritchey good for csce 120
answer: Students rate Philip Ritchey (Computer Science) poorly: they call him a harsh, dismissive grader and the class difficult, and few would take him again. One recent review notes CSCE 120's exams and most assignments are shared across sections, so the professor matters less there. (Susan Ritchey, who is highly rated, teaches Engineering, not CSCE.)

question: is susan ritchey good for engr 102
answer: Yes. Students rate Susan Ritchey (Engineering) very highly and almost all would take her again. ENGR 102 reviews call her kind and clear and say she gives a lot of extra credit.

question: erukhimova phys 206 worth it
answer: Yes. Students rate Tatiana Erukhimova (Physics) among the best professors at A&M and almost everyone would take her again. They say her lectures are engaging with demos, she holds weekly review sessions and learns students' names. Her PHYS 206 sections are honors.

question: how is mahapatra for physics 206
answer: Mixed but mostly positive for PHYS 206. Students say Rupak Mahapatra (Physics) cares about students, encourages questions and uses lots of demos, but his lectures are conceptual with few worked problems and the class is hard. Older PHYS 225 reviews were negative. About half would take him again. (Rabi Mahapatra is a different professor, in Computer Science.)

question: is prof leik good for 221
answer: Students are split on Teresa Leyk (Computer Science, CSCE 221). Reviews say lectures are fast and hard to follow, but labs and TAs help and some call her tough but fair. A bit over half would take her again.

question: eruhimova reviews
answer: Students love Tatiana Erukhimova (Physics): she's rated among the best at A&M and almost everyone would take her again. They praise her engaging lectures with demos and her weekly review sessions.
